mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( M_NUM, ID, PW, NAME, GOODS, AGE, GENDER, K_GRADE, L_GRADE, ADMIN_M, POINT, J_DATE ) VALUES ( M_NUM.NEXTVAL, #{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{goods}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{kGrade}, #{lGrade}, #{adminM}, #{point}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT M_NUM AS mNum, ID AS id, PW AS pw, NAME AS name, GOODS AS goods, AGE AS age, GENDER AS gender, K_GRADE AS kGrade, L_GRADE AS lGrade, ADMIN_M AS adminM, POINT AS point, J_DATE AS jDate, PROFILE_SET AS profileSet FROM MEMBER WHERE ID = #{id} AND PW = #{pw}

SELECT M_NUM AS mNum, ID AS id, PW AS pw, NAME AS name, GOODS AS goods, AGE AS age, GENDER AS gender, K_GRADE AS kGrade, L_GRADE AS lGrade, ADMIN_M AS adminM, POINT AS point, J_DATE AS jDate FROM MEMBER ORDER BY M_NUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO M_ACHIEVEMENT ( M_A_NUM, M_NUM, ACHIEVE_NUM, M_A_DATE, POINT ) VALUES ( M_ACHIEVEMENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{mNum}, #{achieveNum}, SYSDATE, #{point} )
INSERT INTO M_ACHIEVEMENT ( P_S_NUM, M_NUM, GOODS_NUM, GOODS_NAME, GOODS, PRICE, PURCHASE ) VALUES ( POINT_SHOP_HIS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{mNum}, #{goodsNum}, #{goodsName}, #{goods}, #{price}, #{purchase} )
